verdict.rationale: Monday's docs describe a unified agent identity reachable across Slack, WhatsApp, Telegram, Make, MCP, and API ('One identity, every surface — no rebuilding per channel'), plus a unified Models API and webhook/MCP integrations that let agents and tools exchange context without rebuilding connections. This directly addresses cross-tool/agent handoff, but all evidence is first-party marketing/docs with no independent or hands-on confirmation that context/information is actually preserved in practice. Missing for 10: independent verification or case studies showing context/data persists correctly across handoffs, and technical detail on how state/context is passed between surfaces.
